run_dense_eval_hybrid: run the AdsorbML evaluation script to compute hybrid ML+DFT success rates for top-k configurations
run_dense_eval_ml_only: run the AdsorbML evaluation script to compute ML-only success rates with validation against DFT energies
compute_hybrid_success: compute AdsorbML hybrid success rates at varying top-k values comparing ML+DFT energies to ground truth DFT
compute_valid_ml_success: compute validated ML success rates where ML predictions must be within 0.1 eV of DFT energy
filter_ml_data: filter ML data by setting missing systems or configurations to high energy values for failure cases
